records.why: Action commitment names the ACT process of committed action; BE012 states the principle behind it, that the process exists to serve chosen values rather than to change behaviour for its own sake.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE012 saturation; grounded in the opened Hayes, Pistorello & Levin 2012 definition of committed action.

records.why: Psychological flexibility, the ACT model's core target, is defined as persisting or changing behaviour in the service of chosen values; BE012 carries that values-first definition of effective behaviour.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE012 saturation; quote verified in the opened APA PDF.

records.why: A values-driven life is the ongoing pattern this principle aims at: behaviour organised around what a person has chosen to matter rather than around comfort or momentum.
